adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` attempts to model “any numeric expiry field” via computed keys:
```ts
[z.string().toString()]: z.number(),
[z.string().optional().toString()]: z.unknown().optional(),
```
But `z.string()` returns a Zod schema object; calling `.toString()` on it will produce a single literal string key (very likely `"[object Object]"`). That means these are not real index signatures for arbitrary keys, and they also collide into the same property name. As a result, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` is true, `minimumTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(response)` will not properly accept/retain fields like `expires_in`/`expiry_date` (Zod objects strip unknown keys by default unless `.passthrough()`/`.catchall()` is used), breaking the intended “minimum” validation behavior for sync responses.
